notes: New source class that worked: the American Board of Anesthesiology Diplomate Directory, an open unauthenticated JSON API at directoryreactapi.theaba.org, found by climbing the skill's access ladder (theaba.org/directory -> directoryreact.theaba.org React shell -> main.js -> API_URL + endpoint shapes in shipped client code). Endpoints: GET lookups/getCertifications, GET lookups/getstates, GET searchResults/basic?FirstName&LastName, POST searchResults/advanced {FirstName,LastName,City,StateId,ABAId,ProgramType}, GET doctorRecord/getDoctorRecords?ABAId=<digits, dash stripped - the dashed form 400s>. ProgramType 519 = Pediatric Anesthesiology, the exact subspecialty field rounds 1-2 could not reach. Rung-3 payload-parsing beat rung-4 again. TRUNCATION: searchResults/advanced for NC + ProgramType 513 (Anesthesiology) returned exactly 1000 records - a silent ceiling of the same shape as NPI skip=1000 and McLeod paginationLimitedTo; SC 513 = 860 and both peds queries (SC 53, NC 117) are under it, so the subspecialty frame is complete while the parent counts are floors not totals. THE CRITICAL NEGATIVE: ABA City/State is the diplomate's MAILING address, not a practice location. The SC peds census put Desiree Aird MD and John Gantomasso DO at 'Myrtle Beach SC', 1.5 mi from centre - two brand-new in-ring pediatric anesthesiologists. Both rejected: NPI 1528471406 AND Doximity independently place Aird at 1501 N Campbell Ave, Tucson AZ (Univ of Arizona; residency Wayne State 2015-18, fellowship Peds Anesth DMC/Wayne State); NPI 1396064481 places Gantomasso at 777 Hemlock St, Macon GA. Two plausible rows withheld; the ring still contains exactly 1 pediatric anesthesiologist, Michelle D. Lee MD, now double-sourced (McLeod directory + ABA certificate Certified 2026-01-01 thru 2030-12-31). Full-forename lock did heavy work: 94 raw ABA hits -> 85 forename+surname matches -> 47 accepted on agreeing state; 38 withheld including Deeran Patel (Arlington VA) and Michelle Pae Lee (Fullerton CA), a near-miss on the single person the whole benchmark turns on. One diminutive accepted on middle name + city + state + specialty: roster Frederick William Bellamy <-> ABA Fred William Bellamy MD, Myrtle Beach SC. The 29 unmatched are structurally explained: 12 NPI trainees (Student in an Organized Health Care Education/Training Program, not board-eligible), 1 PA-C and 1 CRNA (not ABA-eligible), 15 MD/DO genuinely unchecked - and those 29 are now the highest-value calls, replacing round 2's 12 Tidelands. Round 2's Tidelands gap partially closed from OUTSIDE Tidelands: Ryan Joseph Galica now carries Anesthesiology + Pain Medicine, both Certified thru 2027-12-31, while tidelandshealth.org still 403s. Residency/fellowship program pages are structurally circular for discovery - a program page is indexed BY PROGRAM and the program is the field being filled; 0 of 77 roster names on the MUSC anesthesia residency page. Doximity is inverted: it publishes training only where place fails to corroborate, and gates it where place does corroborate. Both state medical boards are hard-closed by reCAPTCHA, which the skill forbids defeating - so this zero would also be a zero in the OPEN condition.
